facts.text: Melanie and her son were involved in a car accident during a road trip that occurred this past weekend.

evidence.quote: Hey Caroline, that roadtrip this past weekend was insane! We were all freaked when my son got into an accident.
Our trip got off to a bad start. I was really scared when we got into the accident.

facts.text: Melanie's son was unharmed in the accident, and Melanie expressed relief that he was okay.

evidence.quote: We were so lucky he was okay.
Thankfully, my son's ok and that was a reminder that life is precious and to cherish our family.

facts.text: Melanie emphasized the importance of family after the accident, particularly highlighting her gratitude for her loved ones.

evidence.quote: Family's super important to me. Especially after the accident, I've thought a lot about how much I need them.
They mean the world to me and I'm so thankful to have them.

facts.text: Melanie mentioned that her children enjoyed the Grand Canyon during the road trip.

evidence.quote: Thankfully, they enjoyed the Grand Canyon a lot!
